g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
Past runs that executed it are not affected.
- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update — omitted fields a
re left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` acc
ept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.
- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-h
osted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization
's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model l
eases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately — the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also e
xpire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.
- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-determi
nistic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permission and a terminal run. Reserves a 60-sec
ond deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned continuation object with the unchanged draf
t to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…
- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Th
e ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current billi
ng window, and how much of it has been spent.
